mentions.name: LSP servers built with Claude
mentions.description: This effort uses Claude to generate LSP (Language Server Protocol) servers for different programming languages, bringing editor integration such as with Vim.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've also had some fun getting Claude to create LSP servers for different languages, which it has been pretty good at, and that's nice; having good integration with Vim makes a language a lot more fun for me.
